pr_title: Fix potential crash when mashing exit key
pr_body:
See `DialogOverlay`'s logic which sets `CurrentDialog` before load completes.

Closes #24140.

issue_context.title: Crash when exiting game too quickly
issue_context.body:
### Type

Crash to desktop

### Bug description

Crashed after continually pressing the X button on the window. The main menu popup... popped-up (visually) and the game crashed a few milliseconds later.

### Screenshots or videos

_No response_

### Version

https://github.com/ppy/osu/commit/65384d61250bc7db238d189eb361e92ac729de14

### Logs

[runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/11966337/runtime.log)

review_comments: As far as I can tell 99% usages actually add the buttons in _ctor_, and the crashing case is the _only_ one that does it in BDL. So it's a bit weird that this says this. But I agree that BDL should definitely be supported.
